newsitem.title: JAPAN: INTERVIEW--Union Tool sees jump in profit.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW--Union Tool sees jump in profit.

text.p: Japan's Union Tool Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would likely enjoy a 25 percent rise in sales and profits in the current business year to November 1997, much stronger growth than it had anticipated.

Takao Katayama, president of the nation's top maker of piercing drills for printed circuit boards (PCBs), told Reuters that behind the unexpectedly robust earnings outlook was booming demand for its drills from package makers, which sell parts to Intel Corp for the U.S. firm's microprocessors.
